column3: Hmm... Looks like he's not waking up.  Kyou-chan, Kyou-chan.
That's it! If I tried pinching his nose, he might wake up...
He keeps sleeping despite the suffering...?!  No good, at this rate, Kyou-chan will die.
Ah, what a relief. You should be able to breathe now.
Ye-Yes! That's it! R-Right, this'll work!
